features: FIND YOUR PERFECT FIT - Leaf Halo Sizing Kits are unique and don’t match standard kit sizes. Start by ordering our Sizing Kit to ensure the perfect fit. Our samples come in sizes ranging from 7 to 12
TRY BEFORE YOU BUY - Use the Leaf Halo Sizing Kit to determine your accurate size. Wear the sizing sample for at least 24 hours to find the most comfortable fit.

PICK THE RIGHT FINGER - For ideal comfort and enhanced sleep tracking, we recommend wearing your Leaf Halo Sizing Sample on your index finger. To guarantee the best tracking accuracy and comfort, the sample should fit snugly but not rotate freely when you move it on your finger.
ORDER YOUR LEAF HALO SMARTRING - After confirming your size with the Leaf Halo Sizing Kit, you're ready to purchase your Leaf Halo Smart Ring.

SLEEP & STRESS TRACKING: Analyse your sleep stages, such as Deep Sleep, REM Sleep & Light Sleep and get insights into your sleep quality to help your body recover better. With Integrated sleep score to assess your sleep duration and quality. Measure your stress levels to identify stress patterns and manage stress effectively
